// the mixed corpus_jvm_swift directory previously let a C#-only fixture
// (try_catch_coverage.cs.txt) silently satisfy Kotlin's own "catch"
// coverage too, since the unfiltered coverage scan didn't separate
// languages. Kotlin has real try/catch syntax, unlike Go's bare-
// identifier quirk fixtures elsewhere in this package. Measured
// directly against real lizard 1.23.0: complexity 2 (base 1 + catch).
fun f(): Int {
    try {
        return 1
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        return 0
    }
}
